senses.gloss: उत्तिज् Caus. P. To excite, stimulate, instigate, stir up, animate, provoke.

उत्तीर्ण p. p.
—1 Landed, crossed, passed over.
—2 Rescued, delivered.
—3 Released from obligation.
—4 One who has finished his course of studies; experienced, clever.

ऊतिः f. [अव्-क्तिन् P. III. 3. 97]
—1 Weaving, sewing (fr. वे).
—2 Protection; मघवञ्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतिभिः Mahānār. Up. 20. 4.
—3 Enjoyment.
—4 Sport, play अवैति जन्तुः कुमनीष ऊतीः Bhāg. 1. 3. 37, 8. 5. 44.
—5 Favour, kindness.
—6 Aid, assistance, help.
—7 The money given to a tailor for sewing.
—8 Wish, desire; मन्वन्तराणि सद्धर्मऊतयः कर्मवासनाः Bhāg. 2. 10. 4.
—9 Red texture; tissue; अत्र सर्गो विसर्गश्च स्थानं पोषणमूतयः
 Bhāg. 2. 10. 1.
